title: Our Values
summary: The principles that guide how we work together and serve guests.

steps.title: Calm presence
steps.body: Move with care, speak softly, and give each guest your full attention.

steps.title: Warm professionalism
steps.body: Be kind and welcoming without becoming casual or rushed.

steps.title: Discretion
steps.body: Protect guest privacy in conversations, records, and treatment spaces.

steps.title: Excellence in details
steps.body: Linens, scent, timing, and follow-through all communicate our standard.

remember: When in doubt, choose the option that feels most caring and consistent.
